svg.title: Image release process
svg.desc: Five steps. One: source and inputs, a supported Windows image with applications and configuration. Two: build a candidate image version with a repeatable preparation. Three: validate on representative session hosts with apps, sign-in and profiles. Four: approve the release as a production image version and replicate it to the target region. Five: roll out in waves by replacing pooled session hosts and retaining the previous version. If tests fail, fix and rebuild.
